data.title: Takaya
data.about:
Takaya in Motor City is a remarkable development by Union Properties. Featuring three residential towers and a complex of modern villas and townhouses, this development offers a diverse range of residential options to suit various lifestyles. From studios and 1 to 3-bedroom apartments to terraced units, penthouse duplexes, and spacious 4 to 5-bedroom townhouses, Takaya caters to those seeking upscale living with ample space and privacy. Each unit is designed to reflect elegance and modernity, providing a perfect balance of comfort and style.

Beyond its impressive residences, Takaya boasts a wealth of world-class amenities, including beautifully landscaped areas and community spaces. The development offers residents a serene lifestyle surrounded by nature, all within the dynamic heart of Dubai.

characteristics_module.title: Discover Takaya Offering Upscale Family Living
characteristics_module.heading: Unique Selling Points
characteristics_module.description:
• Diverse Living Options: Takaya by Union Properties seamlessly blends 744 apartments, 39 townhouses, 5 villas, retail spaces, and a wealth of luxurious amenities into one cohesive community.
  • Exclusive Amenities: Residents at Takaya enjoy access to a vast range of luxurious amenities, including a swimming pool, gym, workspace, and children's play area.
  • Nature-Inspired Living: The development is designed to harmonize with its natural surroundings, offering peaceful green spaces and walkways.
  • Prime Location: Takaya in Dubai Motor City offers a vibrant lifestyle with easy access to major highways and top attractions in the city.
  • Pet-Friendly Community: Takaya caters to animal lovers, being one of the up-and-coming pet-friendly communities in Dubai.

location_tile.title: Takaya at Dubai Motor City: Find The True Meaning of Home
location_tile.heading: Location
location_tile.description:
Takaya, located in Dubai Motor City, offers an exceptional living experience in one of the city's most vibrant and well-connected communities. Situated close to major highways, residents enjoy easy access to Dubai’s key attractions, including shopping malls, business districts, and iconic landmarks.

Dubai Motor City is known for its unique blend of urban lifestyle and natural green spaces, providing a perfect environment for families and individuals who appreciate outdoor activities, fitness, and relaxation. With amenities such as the Dubai Autodrome, schools, hospitals, and parks nearby, Takaya presents an ideal choice for those seeking modern, convenient living in Dubai Motor City.

  • 01 Minute - Dubai Autodrome
  • 11 Minutes - Dubai International Cricket Stadium
  • 13 Minutes - Miracle Garden
  • 15 Minutes - Dubai Polo & Equestrian Club
  • 15 Minutes - Dubai Hills Mall
  • 15 Minutes - Arabian Ranches
